page0.text:
A high-pitched noise fills the air.
A white blade clatters to the ground, scattering motes of light all around as it reflects the brilliant moonlight.
"...Hh..."
Sticky blood coats his lips.
A man falls to his knees on the stone steps, bidding farewell to his long sword as it sinks into the darkness.

page1.text:
He will never pick up that sword again.
His coat is stained in blood, its newly dyed threads making it resemble a gallant, crimson flower.

page2.text:
"To think...that I'd meet my end...at the hands of some detestable fiend..."
The man's lips seem like white bone in contrast to the fresh blood spilling from his belly.
The vital tremble of life has already left his throat.
Sasaki Kojirou's innards are already functioning as something else.

page3.text:
The mountain gate is quiet.
Neither the Servant guarding it
nor the newly appeared shadow
make a move.
The battle is already over.
Whatever just swiftly ascended the stone steps defeated Assassin.
There was no time to cross blades or even acknowledge the enemy.
Whatever it was, it was in a different dimension altogether.

page4.text:
The gatekeeper's body tears.
His torso is ripped apart. Without a weapon, Assassin cannot even end his own life.
It walks. Steadily, surely.
The shadow lovingly, or perhaps disdainfully, strokes the cheek of the Servant called Assassin.

page5.text:
A spidery, ghoulish arm erupts from his shredded torso.
Bones entangle.
Meat tears.
He feels the organs and entrails that once belonged to him morph into something else.

page6.text:
"Zss!"
He fights the surge of blood that threatens to burst forth.
The swordsman swallows it down, a genial grin playing across his lips.

page7.text:
"...Very well. Do as you wish. Whatever is born from my belly can surely be nothing good."
Eaten from within and deprived of a merciful death, he smiles.
It is a valiant gesture.
His lurid grin is even more fearsome than the birth of the abomination within him.

page8.text:
And so, it is summoned.
The thing born from the blood and entrails of a false Servant is, unmistakably, an Assassin.
"Kii... Kikikikikikiii...!"
Its birthing cries resemble the chitter of insects.
The insect that emerges from the swordsman's body greedily devours its womb.

page9.text:
It cackles as it carves,
chortles as it chews.
With each bite of flesh, the dark insect becomes increasingly man-shaped, its unformed brain gaining human knowledge.
The feast continues for half an hour.
The new Assassin studiously slurps up every last drop of blood, celebrating its birth on now spotless stone steps.

page10.text:
Its only witnesses are the chorally chittering swarms of insects in the brush and the bright, voluminous moon.
The shrill birthing cries fade.

page11.text:
—It is an ill moon.
The white skull sneers at the scorched-black night.
